# Statue

There are a few statues in the garden. Not many, but those you find are quite interesting.

### People vs Events

Some of the statues show famous people. Other statues recognize past events, such as the founding of a religious order.

### Patina

Pay attention to the surface of each statue. The construction materials vary and they age differently, too.
